newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIGA SHIPYARD TO SELL STATE STAKE, EYES LISTING.
newsitem.headline: RIGA SHIPYARD TO SELL STATE STAKE, EYES LISTING.

text.p: Riga Shipyard, eyeing a place on the stock exchange, is to sell the remaining eight percent government stake, the bourse said on Friday.
The stake will be sold on April 14.
"Riga Shipyard has not yet specified, which list it would like to join," Guntars Kokarevich, the bourse's finance department manager, said.
"Knowing that Shipyard's nine month profit for 1996 was above one million lats, the book value of these shares is 1.11 lats," Kokarevichs said.
The company's nine month results of 1996 will be available in the issue prospectus.
"There will be more than 800,000 shares on sale..the price will not be lower than the nominal value of one lat," Kokarevichs said.
